title: Kitties Koop | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * 1 Mile to Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access* 4 Bikes Included* Great Outdoor Areas for Relaxing* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village * Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attraction
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * 1 Mile to Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access* 4 Bikes Included* Great Outdoor Areas for Relaxing* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village * Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!**The community pool is scheduled to be closed for resurfacing from December 1 to December 20, 2025. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. **Escape to Kittie's Koop, a charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home tucked just off 30A and only minutes from the stunning beach. After a fun-filled day by the shore, relax on the rocking chairs on the breezy front porch or gather around the fireplace for a cozy family movie night. The master bedroom features a king-sized bed, and the two guest bedrooms also offer king-sized beds, with Guest Bedroom 2 boasting twin bunk beds with twin trundles—comfortably sleeping 9 guests. Whether you're creating culinary masterpieces in the well-equipped kitchen or enjoying s’mores around the fire pit on the back patio, 28 Merri Way offers the perfect setting to connect with loved ones and create unforgettable memories!Kitties Koop is located in the charming village of Blue Mountain Beach, tucked between Highway 30A and hundreds of acres of State Forest. Kitties Koop is convenient to the beach, shopping, and other hotspots while still being quiet and secluded. You will love the charming community pool and take a stroll to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a delicious treat. This community is centrally located, making it easy to drive to many locations, including the neighboring communities of WaterColor and Seaside. The Bed Setup: Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk beds with 2 Twin TrundlesArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
